qc._primer_note: empty by design — and the length window is INTENTIONALLY unset: ITS amplicon length is highly variable (short ITS2 up to near-full ITS1-5.8S-ITS2). Intake SP2 MUST set min/max length from the lab's primer pair before any run; this preset refuses downstream execution until both are non-zero.

readbased_minimap2.ref_db: biodb-fetch:unite --version 10.2 --taxon_group fungi --type static --file-url <pinned-UNITE-static-fasta-url> (PlutoF DOI-pinned; grab the exact file URL from the UNITE repository page per reference-db catalog)

readbased_idtaxa.ref_db: NO stock IdTaxa model for ITS — opt-in only, after training a custom model from the fetched UNITE FASTA; chain to nf-edna/idtaxa-training. Default classifier is readbased_minimap2.

consensus.classifier_note: ITS consensus classifies via minimap2-LCA against UNITE; no SILVA-model shortcut
